summary: Resets the qualifying-order arrays. When the selector byte at this+0x174 is non-zero it copies the qualifying score field (+18580) of every live vehicle (dword_7C54F0, count dword_5C329C) into dword_7CD2B8 and fills the remainder of the 104-slot array with -1. Otherwise it calls sub_497AD0 with the scene object at this+0x40 and off_5C6674, then fills dword_7CD470 (104 dwords) with -1. Every path ends by setting this+0x178 to -1 and returning -1.

local_names.v4: start of the remainder range in dword_7CD2B8 to fill
local_names.v5: count of remaining dwords to fill

operations.description: If the byte at this+0x174 is zero, take the scene-object path; if non-zero, take the vehicle-score path.
Load the vehicle count v2 from dword_5C329C and start the loop counter result at 0.
For each index result below dword_5C329C, copy the value at dword_7C54F0[result] + 18580 into dword_7CD2B8[result].

If result is below 104 after the copy loop, fill dword_7CD2B8[result] through [103] with 0xFF (4 * (104 - result) bytes, i.e. -1 per dword); if result reached 104 no remainder exists and the fill is skipped.
Set this+0x178 to -1 at the end of the vehicle-score path.
Scene-object path: call sub_497AD0 with the object pointer at this+0x40, the function/vtable table off_5C6674, and argument 0.
Scene-object path: fill dword_7CD470 with 0xFF over 0x1A0 bytes (104 dwords of -1).

The constant 104 (slot count) matches the vehicle-grid capacity in the skeleton fill but is not independently evidenced here.
